caption: The drawing depicts three brown ceramic jugs with decorative blue-gray patterns, arranged on a beige background. Each jug is adorned with intricate designs: the jug at the upper left features a bird standing among stylized leaves and branches; the jug at the upper right displays a heart-shaped outline containing an abstract shape, framed by leafy patterns; and the large jug at the bottom, with a handle on the left, showcases a central heart filled with the initials "WK" and the number "1789" below, surrounded by an ornate leafy motif. The surfaces of the jugs have a mottled appearance, with variations in brown tones, and all three objects feature similar blue-gray decorative accents. The drawing is signed "Yolande De Lasser" in the lower right corner.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
